## Summary
- **Task ID:** WAL-XX (e.g., WAL-03)
- **Feature / Fix:** Brief description of what was added or resolved.

## Type of Change
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Refactor / Code quality enhancement
- [ ] Infrastructure / Configuration update

## Acceptance Criteria Checklist
- [ ] Matches SRS specifications and RFC 2119 keywords
- [ ] Linter passed with 0 errors (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Automated tests passing (`npm test` / `npm run test:e2e`)
- [ ] Tested locally with clean startup (`npm run start:dev` / `npm run dev`)
- [ ] No secrets committed (.env ignored)

## Reviewer Checklist
- [ ] Peer review completed by assigned Dev
- [ ] Ready to merge into `main`
